free_tier.stated: 15 GB on every tier including 原石用户. Real capacity is only sold: 长期VIP 15 GB + 115 TB, 超级版 1 PB + 15 GB, 至尊版 5 PB + 15 GB

per_object_cap.stated: 5 GB per file on a free account, 115 GB on VIP

retention.stated: Not stated in the pages read

egress.terms: No per-GB fee. Free accounts get 普通速度, the ordinary channel; VIP gets the priority channel. Share downloads require a login, so the egress path could not be tested anonymously

tooling: an official open platform at open.115.com with OAuth client id and secret; the OpenList '115_open' driver ships an OpenList-owned key pair so a user can mount without registering an app; the community WebDAV bridge gaoyb7/115drive-webdav
chaining: Nothing to multiply. The desktop clients for Windows, macOS and Linux were withdrawn, so every third-party client depends on reverse-engineered web cookies, and the official API path needs identity-verified developer onboarding

limits.value: 5 GB per file on a free account
the open platform requires 真实姓名, 证件类型, 证件号码, 证件照片 and 有效期 before an app is approved

identity_cost.detail: signup is phone-based, and 115's own support forum answered a foreigner asking about non-mainland numbers with '可以，您是哪个国家和地区的手机号'. The open platform is a second wall: real name, identity document type, number, photograph and expiry

reliability_note: The desktop clients were withdrawn, so third-party access runs on web cookies that break. The share-snap API returns a whole share tree with no auth (a 2.52 PB folder resolved anonymously) and the download call answers 990001 登录超时, so the read gate is absolute

evidence.proved: capacity table 原石用户 15 GB, 特级版 '15 GB + 115 TB', 至尊版 '5 PB + 15 GB'; upload cap 5 GB free and 115 GB VIP
developer onboarding is 签署协议, 入驻资料, 提交认证信息
200, 981 B, no auth, share_title and file_size 2520415095564377 returned
200 with {"state":false,"error":"登录超时，请重新登录。","errno":990001}, so the bytes are gated
a community WebDAV bridge exists, which is the only reason the drive is mountable at all

binding_note: 15 GB free is under the filter and the capacity is paid, but the gate that actually closes it is the identity one: a real-name document for the open platform, or a cookie lifted from a browser session for everything else.
notes: Recorded with both seed verdicts in mind: one wave said fails-quota, another fails-egress. The quota and the egress both fail and the identity wall is the reason neither can be tested; this record carries fails-egress because the read gate is the one that was probed and refused.
